summary: The filing is a Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) reporting an earnings release and conference call for Q1 2026. It includes a press release summarizing financial and operating results, with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The filing confirms routine quarterly reporting with no material event triggering special-situations classification.
